reviews.t: Good price but not for frequent use, zipper may not last
reviews.x: Good price for small clear storage bags, but the zippers feel a little stiff when rounding corners.  Just take it slow or it feels like it’ll break or come apart. Functional for storing items you dont use a lot.  Too fragile for cosmetic bag.

reviews.t: Great solution to my pottery woes!
reviews.x: They are big and clear and durable. I bought these to hold my pottery tools and they are a godsend. And most definitely a bargain! I'm a little concerned that the zippers feel cheap but I haven't had any trouble yet. I will update if I do!

Arrived as expected. Good sizes for travel so u can see everything u brought. I always miss something in my makeup bags that I think I forgot that is hiding at the bottom. This will eliminate that, as I can see everything from the outside.

Great little set of clear bags. Use one in my purse, one in bathroom for daily makeup, larger one for travel items. I like being able to see what’s in there. Easy to clean up when something leaks or spills. Good value. Recommend.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the clear, see-through design for making it easy to find and organize items, especially while traveling.
Many customers find the bags useful for organizing small items like toiletries, cosmetics, baby supplies, and travel essentials.
Several reviewers report durability problems, including split seams and broken zippers.
Some customers note concerns about zipper quality, though others say the zippers have held up fine so far.
A few reviewers mention an initial plastic smell that fades after airing out.
